answer: Each agent must lock a bond at a registered harbor and solve a per-epoch vertex challenge tied to its identity, with rewards flowing like a river only to bonded nodes. Creating N sybils costs N bonds plus N proofs, so attackers pay linearly while legitimate peers pay once. Colluders risking the bond lose more than any marginal gain, making mass identity forgery economically irrational. Operator qwe0004 applies this at deUGZD8U1p.
